decisions.reason: The broad supplement range builds on the established consumer health offer and fits the portfolio-broadening strategy, so without evidence of a shortfall the expanding firm keeps it.
The pharmacy skin and hair supplement sits close to the core and is cheap to carry, and the firm's slack allows keeping it, although there is no recent evidence of its performance.
The joint health product extends the established Trivital brand at low incremental cost, so no clear performance gap triggers search for other uses of the resources.
The niche mushroom supplement only ever got a mention and its results are uncertain, but it is low-cost and near the core, so slack still lets the firm carry it.

The valsartan generic is distant from the core and was hurt by the 2018 recall, but generic blood pressure drugs are staple portfolio items that a firm with in-house manufacturing usually keeps once supply is restored, which leaves the outcome evenly balanced.
The over-the-counter triptan, though distant from the core, fits the strategy of adding consumer health products, and as a recent launch it is given time against aspirations.
